Offers flexible item creation and organization for various credential types
Affordable, open-source solution for a small team
cons: Occasional inconsistencies with browser extension autofill or syncing
Initial setup might have a slight learning curve for some features

changed: Pro 2: The original 'Facilitates easy and secure sharing' was too broad and partially contradicted by notes indicating friction in setting up sharing and organization management.
